description: A note dominated by non-medication content, ending in a negated supplement mention.
input_notes: Nutrition consultation: Patient met with a dietitian to discuss a low-sodium, diabetic-friendly meal plan. Portion sizes and carbohydrate counting were reviewed in detail. Patient reports good understanding of the material and plans to keep a food diary. She denies using any over-the-counter supplements or herbal products at this time.

expected.summary: This nutrition consultation note covers dietary counseling with no current medications; the patient denies using any supplements or herbal products.
